create_XArm6Sim: create an XArm6Sim instance with a bullet_client and offset to load the xarm6 robot and scene objects
step_XArm6Sim: step the XArm6Sim simulation forward by one tick to compute inverse kinematics and control joint positions
reset_XArm6Sim: reset the XArm6Sim simulation state by calling the reset method on the instance
configure_IK_solver: configure the IK solver by toggling useIKFast, useNullSpace, and useDynamics module-level flags
load_xarm_scene: load the xarm6 robot URDF along with tray, lego, and sphere objects into the pybullet client
